direction: Keepfall is fully 3D (the owner, Oct 25 2026: "this game should be all 3d from here on out"). Preserve all current progress.

phase1.notes: Original levels remain intact. Rank studs distinguish levels within a model stage. Shared texture atlases, plain 3D fallback, existing building footprints.

alreadyImported: Toon RTS: footman, archer, worker and peaceful job animations
Four Evil Dragons: all four species and their supported color choices

changes: Controlled camera orbit now that the land is 3D all round.
Cavalry, spearmen or priests as new troops only with defined roles and balance.
Physical-phone performance pass (draw calls ~250, triangles 0.35-0.8M at the widest view).

preserve: Profile identity and current local/remote save namespaces
Building IDs, types, levels, positions, construction and upgrade timers
Gold, Ale, resource production timestamps and claim bookkeeping
Armies, training queues and hero levels
Four hatcheries, unique species choices, colors and individual levels
Glory, shields, raids, defense history and historical replay rules
migrationPolicy: Phase 1 changes only rendering and assets; no save migration or reset is required. Future schema changes must preserve an original copy and use a versioned, repeatable migration with profile-isolation tests.
excludeFromGameImport: Unity editor tutorials and TextMesh Pro editor resources
TimmyRobot, platforming starter assets and sci-fi audio unless a separate use is requested
Duplicate prefab color variants as separate gameplay buildings

full3d.buildings: Every kind but the wall from models/realm/buildings-v1 (barracks, tower, ballista) or world-v1/<kind>.glb, three stages each (hut one); converted by tools/realm/convert-world.mjs from 3DForge, FantasyEnvironments and StylizedDarkCastle prefabs (unity-prefab.mjs, glb-pack.mjs). Stage bands in realm-buildings.js; rank studs within a stage.
full3d.walls: Four designs (palisade 1-2, town stone 3-4, dark brick battlements 5-6, grey stone battlements 7-8): world-v1/walls.glb, a post a tile and rails between.
full3d.land: views/realm-world.js: terrain, water, sky and instanced Unity trees/rocks per scenery theme; no painted landscape. Plain 3D trees stand in when nature.glb is missing.
full3d.characters: Western Kingdoms skeletal models for every troop (footman, archer, knight, thief), workers, cannon crews, guards (spearman), the dragon keeper (priest), the Knight Hero (heavy infantry B), an old replay's Wizard Hero (mage) and the trebuchet's animated catapult.
full3d.raids: Soldiers stacked by the battle are drawn apart in formation (realm-3d.js spreadOut); the battle and replays are untouched.
full3d.fallbacks: realm-models.js plain 3D geometry for any missing model or texture; never a picture.
